blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World-Action Models improve robot control by predicting future visual dynamics, but iterative video denoising incurs substantial inference overhead. Recent approaches reduce this cost through partial future denoising, yet typically rely on fixed refinement budgets. Our empirical observations reveal that preferred refinement depths vary across tasks and states, while different future regions exhibit varying relevance to action generation. Motivated by these findings, we propose Elastic-WAM, which adaptively allocates world refinement computation across temporal denoising time and spatial future space. A unified spatiotemporal refinement demand field governs when to stop world refinement, how far to advance each denoising step, and which regions to refresh. We parameterize this field with a shared temporal basis and spatial amplitudes, and learn it through a three-stage action-grounded supervised procedure. At inference, the learned field guides recurrent sparse world refinement to improve task success while reducing inference overhead. Evaluations across diverse simulation benchmarks and real-world long-horizon manipulation demonstrate state-of-the-art control performance with reduced inference latency.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型通过预测未来的视觉动态来改进机器人控制,但迭代视频去声需要大量的推论费. 最近的办法通过未来的部分取消提名来减少这一费用,但通常依靠固定的完善预算。 我们的经验观察表明,理想的完善深度因任务和州而异,而未来不同区域对行动产生的意义则不同。 基于这些研究结果,我们提出“弹性-WAM”方案,它适应性地将世界的精细计算分配到不同时间去命名的时间和空间未来空间。 一个统一的瞬间完善需求领域支配着何时停止世界完善,推进每个消遣步骤的多远,以及哪些区域需要更新。 我们用一个共同的时间基础和空间振幅参数化这个领域,并通过一个三阶段的行动基础监督程序加以学习。 推论说,所学的实地指导经常进行的稀疏的世界改进,以改进任务的成功,并同时减少推断的间接费用。 跨各种模拟基准的评价和现实世界长视距的操纵,显示了最新控制性能,减少了推论的延迟。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
World-Action Models (WAMs) have shown that predicting future visual dynamics can improve robot control [ 37 , 3 , 1 , 31 , 9 ] .
However, iterative denoising of future videos incurs substantial inference overhead [ 2 , 20 ] .
Recent studies show that intermediate video representations can already support action prediction without complete denoising [ 25 , 24 , 19 ] .
Explicit video generation can even be removed at inference while retaining future prediction as a training objective [ 40 ] .
Nevertheless, these approaches typically adopt a fixed future refinement budget, regardless of the current task or execution state [ 13 , 10 ] .
Consequently, a fixed budget may waste computation in some states while limiting action quality in others [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh:
世界行动模型(WAMS)表明,预测未来的视觉动态可以改善机器人控制[37,3,1,31,9].
然而,对未来的视频进行反复调试需要大量推断。
近期的研究表明,中间视频表现可以支持动作预测而无需完全去名 [25, 24, 19].
清晰的视频生成甚至可以在推断时删除,同时保留未来的预测作为培训目标[40].
然而,这些方法通常采用固定的未来完善预算,而不论目前的任务或执行状况[13、10]。
因此,在某些州,固定预算可能会浪费计算,而在另一些州则会限制行动质量。

blocks.en:
To investigate this limitation, we examine how future video refinement affects downstream action quality across different tasks and states on 10 selected tasks from LIBERO-Plus benchmark [ 12 ] .
As demonstrated in Fig. (a.1), the number of denoising steps yielding the highest success rate varies from one to four.
Even within the same task, different states favor different refinement depths, as shown in Fig. (a.2).
Beyond refinement depth, action-to-video attention maps reveal uneven attention across future video regions (shown in Fig. (a.3)), motivating selective refinement of regions most relevant to action generation [ 38 ] .
Together, these observations motivate adaptive allocation of world refinement computation across both temporal denoising time and spatial future video regions.
blocks.zh:
为了调查这一限制,我们审查未来的视频改进如何影响不同任务的下游行动质量,并说明从LIBERO-Plus基准中选择的10个任务[12]。
如图一.(a.1)所示,成功率最高的降职步骤从一个到四个不等。
即使在同一个任务范围内,不同的国家也倾向于不同的完善深度,如图(a.2)所示。
除了完善的深度外,从行动到视频的注意地图显示,未来视频区域(在图(a.3)中显示)的注意力不均匀,促使有选择地改进与行动产生最相关的区域[38]。
这些观测结果共同促使在时间淡化时间和空间未来视频区域对世界完善计算进行适应性分配。

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose Elastic-WAM , which models the demand for world refinement through a unified spatiotemporal field , as illustrated in Fig. (b).
Its total mass governs when to stop world refinement, its temporal profile determines how far to advance each denoising step, and its spatial variation identifies which future video regions to refresh.
We parameterize this field with a shared temporal basis and spatial amplitudes that separate global refinement demand from relative regional priorities.
We learn this field through three stages of action-grounded supervision, progressively optimizing the temporal profile, relative spatial priorities, and overall refinement demand.
At inference, we start with a dense joint denoising step, use the learned field to guide subsequent sparse world refinement, and continue action denoising after world refinement stops.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提议采用“弹性-WAM”模式,以图(b)为例,通过一个统一的瞬间领域,对世界的完善需求进行模拟。
它的总质量决定了何时停止世界的完善,它的时间特征决定了推进每个去诺步骤的多远,它的空间变异确定了未来需要刷新的视频区域.
我们以共同的时间基础和空间振幅对这一领域进行参数化,将全球完善需求与相对的区域优先事项区分开来。
我们通过三个以行动为基础的监督阶段来学习这个领域,逐步优化时间概况、相对空间重点和总体完善需求。
推想,我们从密集的联名解密步骤入手,用所学领域来指导后来的稀有世界完善,再在世界完善停止后继续采取解密行动.

blocks.en:
We evaluate Elastic-WAM across in-distribution [ 21 ] , out-of-distribution [ 12 , 49 ] , and more complex manipulation simulation benchmarks [ 4 ] , as well as a real-world long-horizon tea preparation task.
Our results demonstrate state-of-the-art control performance among methods without large-scale embodied pretraining, while reducing inference latency by 32.2% compared with Joint-WAM on RoboCasa-GR1, as shown in Fig. (c).
blocks.zh:
我们评价 Elastic-WAM 横跨分流[21],分出分流[12,49],以及更复杂的操纵模拟基准[4],以及现实世界长视茶制任务.
我们的结果显示,在不进行大规模预训的方法中,最先进的控制性能,同时与RoboCasa-GR1上的联合-WAM相比,推论延迟度减少了32.2%。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We formulate adaptive world refinement through a unified spatiotemporal demand field, jointly governing when to stop, how far to advance, and where to refresh future video representations. • We develop an action-grounded supervised learning framework and recurrent sparse inference strategy, enabling adaptive refinement with a frozen WAM backbone. • We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks, while substantially reducing inference latency.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 通过统一的瞬间需求领域,我们制定适应性世界的完善措施,共同规范何时停止、前进多远、在何处更新未来的视频表述。 • 我们制定了基于行动的监督学习框架和经常性的零星推论战略,使WAM主干网能够进行适应性改进。 我们在模拟基准和现实世界操纵任务中展示最先进的性能,同时大大减少推论的延迟。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
World-Action Models. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have evolved from directly predicting robot actions [ 6 , 17 , 5 , 27 , 14 , 35 ] to leveraging future visual predictions to guide action generation [ 45 , 8 , 43 , 33 , 34 ] .
World-Action Models (WAMs) further extend the VLA paradigm by jointly modeling future visual dynamics and robot actions [ 37 , 3 , 16 , 31 ] .
To improve inference efficiency, recent approaches exploit partially denoised video representations [ 25 , 24 , 19 ] , modality-aware step distillation [ 2 ] , or compact video experts with sparse latents and asymmetric denoising [ 18 ] .
Other methods eliminate explicit future generation at inference [ 40 ] or preserve future conditioning through sparse video–action interactions [ 47 ] .
Complementary to these approaches, our Elastic-WAM adaptively allocates computation within the recurrent world refinement process of a frozen WAM, across both temporal denoising time and spatial future video regions.
blocks.zh:
世界行动模式。 Vision-Langage-Action(VLA)模型从直接预测机器人动作[6,17,5,27,14,35]演变为利用未来的视觉预测来引导动作生成[45,8,43,33,34].
世界行动模式(WAMS)通过联合建模未来视觉动态和机器人动作[37,3,16,31]进一步扩大了VLA范式.
为了提高推论效率,最近的方法利用了部分去名化的视频演示[25、24、19]、模式意识分级蒸馏[2],或具有稀少潜伏和不对称去名化的紧凑视频专家[18]。
其他方法消除了明确的后代推断[40]或通过稀少的视频-动作互动来保持未来调节[47].
除了这些方法之外,我们的“弹性-WAM”在反复出现的世界改进过程中,在时间消音时间和空间未来视频区域对被冻结的WAM进行适应性分配计算。

blocks.en:
Temporally Adaptive Denoising. Diffusion sampling has been accelerated through implicit samplers, efficient ODE solvers, and consistency distillation [ 28 , 22 , 23 ] , typically using predefined schedules across inputs.
Recent approaches further adapt denoising computation to individual inputs: AdaDiff learns sample-specific step budgets [ 41 ] , while AdaptiveDiffusion skips redundant noise predictions based on intermediate latent changes [ 36 ] .
For robotic control, D3P dynamically allocates action denoising steps according to state-dependent action importance [ 39 ] , while SANTS learns adaptive stopping and noise progression for WAMs based on downstream action quality [ 30 ] .
While these methods adapt computation along the denoising trajectory, Elastic-WAM jointly governs temporal refinement and spatial future token updates through a unified spatiotemporal refinement field.
blocks.zh:
短暂的适应性 Denoising. 通过隐含的采样器,高效的ODE解析器,以及一致性分馏[28,22,23]等方法加快了分泌采样速度,一般使用预先确定的跨输入表.
近期的办法进一步使代号计算适应个人投入: AdaDiff学习了特定样本步骤预算[41],而可适应的Diffusion跳过基于中间潜在变化的冗余噪声预测[36].
对于机器人控制,D3P动态地根据状态依赖性动作重要性分配动作去Noing步骤[39],而SANTS则根据下游动作质量为WAM学习适应性停止和噪音进取[30].
虽然这些方法沿去诺氏轨迹调整了计算,但弹性-WAM通过统一的瞬间精炼领域共同管理时间精炼和空间未来符号更新。

blocks.en:
Spatially Adaptive Computation. Spatial redundancy in diffusion transformers has motivated methods that concentrate computation on selected tokens or attention interactions.
VSA introduces trainable sparse attention by identifying important token interactions [ 42 ] , while VORTA dynamically routes computation among sparse attention patterns [ 29 ] .
Jenga combines dynamic attention carving with progressive resolution generation [ 44 ] .
Beyond attention sparsification, DyDiT dynamically adjusts computation across denoising timesteps and spatial locations [ 46 ] , while token-wise feature caching selectively reuses intermediate features across denoising steps [ 50 ] .
Elastic-WAM learns to selectively refresh future video queries based on their contribution to downstream action prediction, preserving full logical attention context and coordinating spatial refinement with temporal decisions through a unified field.
blocks.zh:
空间适应计算. 扩散变压器的空间冗余激发出将计算集中在所选符号或注意力相互作用的方法.
VSA通过识别出重要的符号相互作用[42],引入了可受训练的稀有关注,而VORTA则在稀有关注模式中动态地进行计算[29].
Jenga将动态关注雕刻与渐进分辨率生成相结合 [44].
除了注意力溅射外,DyDIT还动态地调整了对去诺定时阶和空间位置的计算[46],而象征性地切入则有选择地再利用跨去诺定时阶的中间特征[50].
弹性-WAM学习根据对未来下游动作预测的贡献,有选择地刷新未来的视频查询,保留完整的逻辑关注背景,并通过一个统一的领域来协调空间完善与时间决定.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , Elastic-WAM allocates world refinement computation according to the remaining refinement demand at each state.
We model this demand over denoising progression and future video space through a unified spatiotemporal field, where geometry-aware local curves describe the refinement needs of different regions (Sec. 3.1 ).
Since future video regions share the same denoising trajectory, we use a common temporal profile while allowing each region to have a different refinement amplitude.
Together, these components determine when to stop world refinement, how far to advance each denoising step, and which future video regions to refresh (Sec. 3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,Elastic-WAM根据每个州的剩余完善需求分配世界完善计算。
我们通过一个统一的相片场来模拟这种要求,而不是去Noing Progress和未来的相片空间,在那里,几何感知到的地方曲线描述了不同地区的完善需要(第3.1节)。
由于未来影视区域拥有相同的去声轨迹,我们使用一个共同的时间剖面,同时允许每个区域有不同的精度振幅.
这些组件共同决定了何时停止世界的完善,推进每个去名步骤有多远,以及未来哪些视频区域需要刷新(第3.2条)。

blocks.en:
With the pretrained WAM frozen, we learn the field through three stages of action-grounded supervision: first its temporal profile, then the relative refinement priorities of future video regions, and finally the overall demand for continued world refinement (Sec. 3.3 ).
At inference, Elastic-WAM begins with a dense joint denoising step, recurrently refreshes selected future video queries while preserving the full logical attention context, and continues action denoising using the cached video representation after world refinement stops (Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh:
在经过预先训练的WAM被冻结后,我们通过三个基于行动的监督阶段来学习这个领域:首先是其时间概况,然后是未来视频区域相对完善的优先事项,最后是持续完善世界的总体需求(第3.3条)。
推想出,Elastic-WAM开始采取密集的联合调试步骤,经常刷新所选择的未来视频查询,同时保留了完整的逻辑关注上下文,并在世界完善停止后继续使用缓存视频表示来进行调试(第3.4节).

At each replanning cycle, Elastic-WAM begins with a dense joint denoising step over all future video tokens, establishing the recurrent state and layer-wise key–value cache.
The learned refinement field then determines whether to continue world refinement and, if so, selects the next denoising progression and the future video regions to refresh (Sec. 3.2 ).
All video and action latents are advanced to the next noise level, while the selected exact-token mask determines which future video queries are recomputed in the subsequent step.
This process repeats with updated refinement decisions at each step.
blocks.zh:
在每一个重新规划周期中,Elastic-WAM首先对所有未来视频符号采取密集的联合去诺步骤,建立经常状态和分层键-值缓存。
然后,学习到的完善领域决定是否继续完善世界,如果是,则选择下一个取消提名的进展和未来视频区域进行更新(第3.2条)。
所有视频和动作潜伏被推进到下一个噪声级别,而所选取的精确被敲住的口罩则决定了未来哪些视频查询在接下来的一步中重算.
这一过程重复了每一步骤的最新完善决定。

During sparse joint updates, observation and action queries remain dense, while the selected future video queries retain access to the full logical key–value context.
Unselected future video tokens preserve their cached hidden states, keys, values, and last-refresh velocities, which are reused as their latents continue to evolve.
Once the cumulative World Commit threshold is reached or a safety condition is triggered, Elastic-WAM stops world refinement and directly reuses the current video representation and layer-wise cache for subsequent action denoising.
No additional video prefill is required after World Commit .

未选择的未来视频符号保留了它们被缓存的隐藏状态,密钥,值,以及最后再现的速度,随着其潜伏性的持续演化,它们被再用.
一旦达到累积的World Commission阈值或触发了安全条件,Elastic-WAM停止了世界的完善,并直接再用当前视频表现和分层缓存,用于随后的去诺化行动.
World Commission 之后不需要额外的视频预填 。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: Our experiments address four key questions: • Q1: How well does Elastic-WAM perform under increasingly challenging manipulation conditions? • Q2: How does our Elastic-WAM balance control performance and inference cost? • Q3: How does adaptive temporal and spatial refinement contribute to control performance? • Q4: How robust is our Elastic-WAM in real-world long-horizon manipulation under lighting and object changes?

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate Elastic-WAM on LIBERO [ 21 ] for standard manipulation, LIBERO-Plus [ 12 ] for robustness under visual and environmental perturbations, and LIBERO-Pro [ 49 ] for generalization across object, position, language, and task variations.
We further evaluate complex manipulation performance and inference efficiency on RoboCasa-GR1 [ 4 ] .
For real-world evaluation, we consider a four-stage bimanual tea preparation task under nominal conditions, lighting changes, and object replacement.
blocks.zh:
我们评价LIBERO上的弹性-WAM[21]用于标准操纵,LIBERO-Plus[12]用于视觉和环境扰动下的坚固性,LIBERO-Pro[49]用于跨对象、位置、语言和任务变化的概括。
我们进一步评价RoboCasa-GR1的复杂操纵性能和推论效率[4].
对于现实世界的评价,我们考虑在名义条件下进行四阶段双人制茶任务,照明改变,取出取物.

blocks.en:
We compare Elastic-WAM against existing policies, including Joint-WAM [ 47 ] and Fast-WAM [ 40 ] , while keeping the pretrained WAM frozen during refinement field learning.
On LIBERO-Plus and LIBERO-Pro, the LIBERO-trained policy is evaluated without additional adaptation.
We report task success rates across simulation benchmarks, inference latency on RoboCasa-GR1, and the full-task success rate (SR) and the average task progress (PS) in real-world experiments.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了弹性-WAM与现行政策,包括联合-WAM[47]和快-WAM[40],同时在完善实地学习时保持预先训练的WAM被冻结.
在LIBERO-Plus和LIBERO-Pro上,对LIBERO训练有素的政策进行评价而不作进一步调整.
我们报告各项模拟基准的任务成功率、RoboCasa-GR1的推断延迟率、全任务的成功率和现实世界实验的平均任务进度。

blocks.zh: 4.2 与最新方法的比较

LIBERO. Elastic-WAM achieves the highest average success rate on LIBERO (Table 4 ), with notable improvements over Joint-WAM on the Long suite.

blocks.en:
Long-Horizon Analysis. Long-horizon manipulation requires policies to recognize task progress from evolving visual observations and generate actions appropriate to each execution stage.
Without an explicit task-progress memory module, the evaluated policies must largely infer their current stage from visual information.
We hypothesize that jointly adapting the temporal progression and spatial allocation of future refinement helps Elastic-WAM capture stage-dependent visual changes more effectively, thereby facilitating task-state discrimination and stage-appropriate action generation.
This interpretation is consistent with its superior performance on the LIBERO Long suite (Table 4 ) and higher task progress in real-world experiments (Table 7 ), suggesting that adaptive spatiotemporal refinement may also benefit long-horizon task execution.

没有一个明确的任务进度内存模块,所评价的政策必须在很大程度上从视觉信息中推断其目前阶段。
我们假设,联合调整未来改进的时间进展和空间分配有助于更有效地捕捉依赖阶段的视觉变化,从而促进任务状态歧视和适合阶段的行动生成。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we presented Elastic-WAM, a unified framework for adaptively allocating world refinement computation across temporal denoising time and spatial future video space.
By modeling the remaining refinement demand through a spatiotemporal field, Elastic-WAM jointly determines when to stop world refinement, how far to advance each denoising step, and which future video regions to refresh.
We learn this field through three stages of action-grounded supervision and enable efficient inference through recurrent sparse refinement while preserving the full logical attention context.
Extensive experiments across diverse simulation benchmarks and real-world long-horizon manipulation demonstrate state-of-the-art control performance with reduced inference latency.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了Elastic-WAM,这是一个适应性地分配世界精细计算在时间去诺时间和空间未来视频空间的统一框架.
Elastic-WAM通过一个瞬间领域模拟其余的完善需求,共同决定了何时停止世界的完善,推进每个去诺步骤的多远,以及未来哪些视频区域需要刷新.
我们通过三个以行动为基础的监督阶段来学习这个领域,并且能够通过经常性的微小改进来有效推论,同时保持充分合理的关注背景。
跨越各种模拟基准和现实世界长视距操纵的广泛实验显示了最先进的控制性能,并减少了推论延迟。

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实施情况

blocks.en: A.1 Base World-Action Model
blocks.zh: A.1 基础世界行动模式

blocks.en:
We build Elastic-WAM upon FastWAM-Joint, a pretrained world-action model that jointly refines future video representations and robot actions through iterative denoising.
FastWAM-Joint is the same model referred to as Joint-WAM in Faster-WAM [ 47 ] ; we use the former name to describe our backbone and the latter for baseline comparisons.
The model follows the joint video-action denoising configuration used by the Joint-WAM baseline [ 47 ] .
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , language instructions are processed by a T5 encoder, visual observations are encoded through a VAE, and proprioceptive states are mapped into the model’s feature space through a projection layer.
The joint denoising backbone processes observation, future-video, and action tokens, allowing future visual representations to provide conditioning for action generation.
In our configuration, the future-video stream contains 196 tokens, which are organized into 64 geometry-aware groups for adaptive spatial refinement.
Throughout the three-stage refinement field training, all pretrained WAM parameters remain frozen.
Elastic-WAM preserves the underlying action generation mechanism while adaptively controlling the temporal and spatial computation devoted to future video refinement.
blocks.zh:
我们在FastWAM-United上建立了“弹性-WAM”,这是一种经过预先培训的世界行动模式,通过迭代去诺来共同改进未来的视频表现和机器人行动。
FastWAM-United是"快活-WAM"中被称作"联合-WAM"的同一种模式;我们使用前一个名称来描述我们的骨干和后一个用于基线比较.
该模型沿用了联合-WAM基线所使用的联合视频-动作解音配置[47].
如图2所示,语言指令由T5编码器处理,视觉观测通过VAE编码,自发状态通过投影层被映射到模型的特征空间.
联合去名骨干进程观察,未来-视频,以及动作符号,使未来的视觉表现为动作生成提供条件.
在我们的配置中,未来-视频流包含有196个符号,它们被组织成64个几何感知组,用于适应性空间完善.
在整个三阶段的改进实地培训中,所有经过预先培训的WAM参数仍然被冻结。
弹性-WAM保留了基本的动作生成机制,同时适应性地控制用于未来视频改进的时间和空间计算.

blocks.en: A.2 Simulation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: A.2 模拟基准

blocks.en: We evaluate Elastic-WAM across four simulation benchmarks covering standard manipulation, out-of-distribution generalization, and complex robotic interactions.
blocks.zh: 我们通过四个模拟基准来评价“弹性-WAM”,这些基准包括标准操纵、分配外一般化和复杂的机器人互动。

blocks.en:
LIBERO. LIBERO [ 21 ] comprises four manipulation suites: Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long.
Each suite contains 10 language-conditioned tasks, covering spatial reasoning, object manipulation, goal-conditioned execution, and extended action sequences.
We evaluate each task over 50 rollouts, resulting in 2,000 evaluation episodes across all four suites.
We report the success rate of each suite and the average performance across suites.
blocks.zh:
LIBERO. LIBERO[21]包括四个操纵套房:空间,对象,目标,和长.
每个套件包含10个语言条件任务,涵盖空间推理,对象操纵,目标条件执行,以及扩展动作序列等.
我们评价每项任务超过50次,结果在所有四个套间中都有2 000次评价。
我们报告每套套房的成功率和各套房的平均业绩。

blocks.en:
LIBERO-Plus. LIBERO-Plus [ 12 ] evaluates robustness under seven categories of distribution shifts: camera viewpoint, robot initialization, language instruction, illumination, background appearance, sensor noise, and object layout.
We directly evaluate the LIBERO-trained policy without additional adaptation to these perturbations.
We report success rates for individual perturbation categories and aggregate overall performance across evaluation episodes, accounting for the number of episodes in each category.
blocks.zh:
LIBERO-Plus. LIBERO-Plus [12] 在七类分布相变下评价稳健性:相机视角,机器人初始化,语言指导,发光,背景外观,传感器噪音,和物体布局.
我们直接评价LIBERO训练的政策,而不对这些干扰作进一步调整。
我们报告个别扰动类别的成功率,并报告各评价阶段的总体业绩,说明每一类别中节目的数量。

blocks.en:
LIBERO-Pro. LIBERO-Pro [ 49 ] evaluates generalization across four categories: Object, Position, Semantic, and Task.
These settings examine robustness to changes in manipulated objects, object positions, language semantics, and task configurations.
As with LIBERO-Plus, we evaluate the LIBERO-trained policy without additional fine-tuning.
We report category-wise success rates and their unweighted average.
blocks.zh:
LIBERO-Pro.LIBERO-Pro[49]评价了四类的概括: 对象、位置、语义和任务。
这些设置检查了被操纵对象、对象位置、语言语义和任务配置的强性变化。
与LIBERO-Plus一样,我们评价LIBERO训练政策,而不进行额外的微调.
我们按类别报告成功率及其未加权平均数。

blocks.en:
RoboCasa-GR1. RoboCasa-GR1 [ 4 ] evaluates complex tabletop manipulation across 24 tasks involving object rearrangement and interactions with articulated objects.
The benchmark covers diverse manipulation scenarios, including cabinets, drawers, microwaves, cutting boards, placemats, plates, and trays.
We report task success rates and overall performance to assess the effectiveness of adaptive refinement in challenging manipulation settings.
We follow the evaluation setting used by StarVLA [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh:
RoboCasa-GR1. RoboCasa-GR1[4]评价涉及物体重排和与被阐明物体的相互作用的24个任务的复杂平顶操纵.
该基准涵盖各种操纵情况,包括柜子、抽屉、微波炉、切割板、胎盘、盘子和托盘。
我们报告任务的成功率和总体业绩,以评估在具有挑战性的操纵环境中适应性改进的有效性。
我们遵循StarVLA使用的评价设置 [11].

blocks.en: A.3 Inference Efficiency and Hardware
blocks.zh: A.3 效率和硬件

blocks.en:
We measure inference latency on an NVIDIA H800 GPU using the RoboCasa-GR1 benchmark.
We report inference latency in milliseconds alongside task success rates to evaluate the trade-off between control performance and computational efficiency.
As reported in Table 4 , Elastic-WAM reduces inference latency by 32.2% compared with Joint-WAM while achieving higher task success.
This efficiency improvement is enabled by adaptive temporal refinement, selective future-video token updates, and cache reuse during action generation.
blocks.zh:
我们用RoboCasa-GR1基准衡量NVIDIA H800GPU的推断延迟。
我们报告假设延迟数以毫秒计,同时报告任务成功率,以评估控制性能与计算效率之间的取舍。
如表4所报告, " 弹性 -- -- WAM " 与 " 联合 -- -- WAM " 相比减少了32.2%的推断延迟,同时取得了更高的任务成功。
这种效率的提高是通过适应性时间精炼、有选择地更新未来视频信号和在行动生成过程中缓存再利用来实现的。

blocks.en: Appendix B Additional Simulation Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录B 其他模拟实验

blocks.en: B.1 Precision-Sensitive Manipulation
blocks.zh: B.1 精密敏感操纵

blocks.en:
We provide additional qualitative comparisons on the RoboCasa-GR1 to examine manipulation behaviors requiring precise object placement.
As shown in Fig. 5 , we compare Elastic-WAM with Fast-WAM on two representative tasks: placing a bottle into a cabinet and placing a can into a drawer.
blocks.zh:
我们提供了更多关于RoboCasa-GR1的质量比较,以审查需要精确放置物体的操纵行为。
如图5所示,我们将Elastic-WAM和Fast-WAM两个具有代表性的任务进行比较:把一瓶放入柜中,把一罐放入抽屉.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 : Precision-sensitive manipulation on RoboCasa-GR1. Qualitative comparisons between Fast-WAM (top) and Elastic-WAM (bottom) on (a) Bottle into Cabinet and (b) Can into Drawer.
Keyframes progress from left to right, highlighting the final placement stage.
Fast-WAM fails to complete the placement, whereas Elastic-WAM successfully finishes both tasks.
blocks.zh:
图5:对RoboCasa-GR1进行精密敏感的操纵。 Fast-WAM(上部)和Elastic-WAM(下部)在(a)瓶入内阁和(b)罐入抽取器方面进行定性比较。
关键框架从左到右的进展,突出最后放置阶段.
Fast-WAM无法完成安放,而Elastic-WAM则能成功完成两个任务.

blocks.en:
In both examples, Fast-WAM moves the objects toward their target locations but fails to complete the final placement, whereas Elastic-WAM successfully executes the manipulation.
These observations suggest that selectively continuing future refinement can provide more effective conditioning for precision-sensitive actions, where reaching the target vicinity alone is insufficient for successful task completion.
blocks.zh:
在这两个例子中,快取-WAM将对象移动到目标位置,但未能完成最终定位,而"弹性-WAM"成功执行操纵.
这些意见表明,今后有选择地继续加以改进,可以为精确敏感的行动提供更有效的条件,因为仅接近目标不足以成功完成任务。

blocks.en: Appendix C Additional Real-World Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录C 真实世界实验

blocks.en: C.1 Robotic Platform and Data Collection
blocks.zh: C.1 机器人平台和数据收集

blocks.en:
We conduct real-world experiments on a bimanual robotic platform equipped with two UFACTORY xArm 7 manipulators.
The tabletop workspace contains two teapots and multiple cups, requiring coordinated manipulation of different objects throughout a long-horizon tea-preparation task.
The evaluation involves successive grasping, placement, pouring, and object-return operations, with changes in object configurations across execution stages.
We additionally record head-camera and wrist-camera views to visualize the robot’s execution behavior.
blocks.zh:
我们在一个双人机器人平台上进行现实世界的实验,配备了两个UFACTORY xArm 7操纵器.
桌顶工作空间包含两个茶壶和多杯子,需要协调地操纵不同物体,完成长相相间的茶前准备任务.
评估涉及连续的抓取,放置,倒入和取回对象操作,各执行阶段对象配置的变化.
我们额外记录头相机和手相机的观点,

blocks.en:
We collect 200 demonstration trajectories for the four-stage tea-preparation task.
The underlying world-action policies are prepared following the standard FastWAM-Joint training procedure.
For Elastic-WAM, the pretrained WAM backbone remains frozen during subsequent refinement field learning, as described in Sec. 3 .
This setup allows us to evaluate the effect of adaptive world refinement on long-horizon manipulation without modifying the underlying action generation architecture.
blocks.zh:
我们收集了200个示范轨迹,用于四级茶叶制备任务.
基本的世界行动政策是按标准FastWAM-联合培训程序制定的。
就弹性-WAM而言,如第3节所述,经过预先训练的WAM骨干在随后的精细实地学习期间仍然被冻结。
这种设置使我们能够评价适应性世界的完善对长视野操纵的影响,而不修改基本的动作生成架构.

blocks.en: C.2 Task and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: C.2 任务和评价议定书

blocks.en:
Long-Horizon Task. We design a four-stage tea-preparation task requiring the robot to execute a sequence of coordinated bimanual operations.
The complete language instruction is: “Place the white cup on top of the uncovered teapot, pour tea from the covered teapot into the white cup, return the white cup to its original position, then pour tea from the uncovered teapot into the black cup and return the teapot to its original position.”
blocks.zh:
长征任务. 我们设计出一个四阶段的茶叶准备任务,要求机器人执行一系列协调的双人操作.
完整的语言教导是:"将被揭开的茶壶上方的白色杯子放入被揭开的茶壶上方,从被揭开的茶壶倒入白杯子,将白杯子还原到原来的位置上,再从被揭开的茶壶倒入黑杯子,将被揭开的茶壶还原到原来的位置上. “

blocks.en:
The task consists of four sequential stages.
In the first stage, the robot grasps the white cup and places it on the uncovered teapot.
In the second stage, it manipulates the covered teapot to pour tea into the white cup.
In the third stage, the robot retrieves the white cup and returns it to its original position.
Finally, it pours tea from the uncovered teapot into the black cup and returns the teapot to its original position.
Successful task execution requires completing all four stages in sequence without human intervention.
blocks.zh:
这项任务包括四个相继阶段。
在第一阶段,机器人抓住了白色杯子,并把它放在被揭开的茶壶上.
在第二阶段,它操纵被覆盖的茶壶将茶倒入白杯.
在第三阶段,机器人取回了"白杯"并还原回原位.
最后从被揭开的茶壶倒入了黑杯,将茶壶还回了原来的位置.
要成功完成任务,就必须在没有人类干预的情况下,连续完成所有四个阶段。

blocks.en:
Evaluation Conditions. We evaluate Elastic-WAM, Joint-WAM, and Fast-WAM under three conditions: Nominal, Lighting OOD, and Object OOD, as illustrated in Fig. 4 .
The Nominal condition uses the standard tabletop environment and object configuration.
Lighting OOD introduces neon illumination to alter the visual appearance of the scene.
Object OOD replaces the original white cup with a silver-colored cup of a slightly different shape throughout the manipulation sequence.
These perturbations evaluate the robustness of long-horizon execution to changes in scene appearance and object characteristics.
blocks.zh:
评价条件。 如图4所示,我们在三个条件下对“弹性-WAM”、“联合-WAM”和“快-WAM”进行评估:名词、照明-OD和对象-OOD。
名词条件使用标准平面环境和对象配置.
照明OD引入了霓虹灯来改变场景的视觉外观.
对象OOD用银色的杯子来取而代之,整个操纵序列的形状略有不同.
这些扰动评价了长视距执行对场景外观和物体特征变化的稳健性.

blocks.en:
Each method is evaluated over 20 trials per condition.
All methods are required to complete the same four-stage task under the corresponding evaluation setting.
blocks.zh:
每种方法都经过20多次试验。
所有方法都需要在相应的评价环境中完成相同的四阶段任务。

blocks.en:
Evaluation Metrics. We report two complementary metrics: full-task success rate (SR) and progress score (PS).
A trial is considered successful only when all four stages are completed.
The full-task success rate is defined as the percentage of trials satisfying this criterion.
blocks.zh:
评价计量。 我们报告两个互补的衡量标准:全任务成功率和进度分数。
只有完成所有四个阶段,审判才被视为成功。
全任务成功率被定义为符合这一标准的审判百分比。

blocks.en:
The progress score measures the average fraction of successfully completed stages across evaluation trials.
Each stage contributes one point only when all operations within that stage are completed.
For a four-stage task, the number of completed stages is divided by four and averaged across trials, with the resulting score expressed as a percentage.
Unlike full-task success, PS captures partial task completion and provides a more detailed measure of execution progress when a policy fails before completing the entire sequence.
The quantitative results are presented in Table 7 .
blocks.zh:
进展分数衡量整个评价试验阶段成功完成的平均分数。
每个阶段只有在完成该阶段的所有行动时,才贡献一分。
对于一个分四个阶段的任务,完成的阶段数除以四个阶段,并平均进行各种审判,所得分数以百分比表示.
与全任务成功不同,PS抓取了部分任务完成,并在一个政策在完成整个序列前失败时,提供了更详细的执行进度的度量.
量化结果见表7。

blocks.en: C.3 Qualitative Long-Horizon Execution
blocks.zh: C.3 定性长期处决

blocks.en:
We provide additional qualitative results illustrating a successful long-horizon tea-preparation rollout with Elastic-WAM.
Figure 6 presents representative keyframes from all four execution stages, including the corresponding wrist-camera observations.
The visualization captures the progression of the manipulation sequence from initial cup placement to the final pouring and object-return operations.
blocks.zh:
我们提供了更多的质量结果,说明与Elastic-WAM一起成功地开展了长视距茶叶准备活动。
图6列出了所有四个执行阶段具有代表性的关键框架,包括相应的腕相机观测。
可视化能捕捉到从初始杯放置到最终倒入和取回对象操作的操纵序列的进展.

blocks.en:
Figure 6 : Qualitative visualization of real-world long-horizon manipulation. Keyframes illustrate a successful four-stage tea-preparation rollout using Elastic-WAM. Stage 1: Grasping, lifting, aligning, and placing the white cup on the uncovered teapot. Stage 2: Grasping and manipulating the covered teapot to pour tea into the white cup. Stage 3: Retrieving and returning the white cup to its original position. Stage 4: Pouring tea into the black cup and returning the uncovered teapot.
The head-camera keyframes and corresponding wrist-camera views illustrate the progression of robot actions throughout the task.
blocks.zh:
图6:真实世界长视野操纵的定性可视化. 关键框架说明了利用Elastic-WAM成功推出的四级茶叶准备. 阶段 1:将取出,取出,调和,并放入被揭开的茶壶上放出白杯. 阶段 2:取出并操纵被覆盖的茶壶倒入白杯. 第3阶段:取回并归还白杯原地. 阶段 4:将茶入黑杯并还回被揭开的茶壶.
头相机键框和相应的手腕相机观点说明了机器人行动在整个任务过程中的进展.

blocks.en:
Throughout the rollout, the robot successfully performs successive grasping, placement, pouring, and object-return operations as the scene configuration evolves.
Each completed stage changes the positions or states of task-relevant objects, requiring subsequent actions to be generated according to the updated visual observations.
This example illustrates Elastic-WAM’s ability to sustain coordinated manipulation across multiple execution stages and complements the quantitative long-horizon results reported in Sec. 4.4 .
blocks.zh:
在整个推出过程中,随着场景配置的演化,机器人成功相继地进行抓取,放置,倒灌,和物体回放等操作.
每个完成的阶段都会改变任务相关对象的位置或状态,需要根据更新的视觉观测生成后续动作.
这一例子表明,超弹性-WAM有能力在多个执行阶段保持协调的操纵,并补充第4.4节所报告的长期定量结果。
